name: Verdant Engine
purpose: Commercial 3D browser and WebAssembly game engine with procedural terrain, PBR materials, glTF 2.0 export, WGSL shaders, rigid-body physics, spatial audio, and verified architectural statics.

promise.headline: Runs 60fps 3D worlds in the browser with verified causal expansion and structural equilibrium.
promise.detail: Every expansion epoch from initial seed to present observation and every constructed architectural or kinetic artifact is checked for causal ordering and static equilibrium.

claim: VE-10: the engine verifier answers conformant only for monotonic expansion epochs and structurally balanced architectural or kinetic blueprints, refuses out-of-epoch or unstable blueprints, and answers invalid request for unknown queries.

proposition.name: BlueprintValid
proposition.text:
BlueprintValid blueprint :=
  blueprint.epochRank = 3
  /\ 6 * blueprint.eccentricityUnits <= blueprint.thicknessUnits
  /\ 2 <= blueprint.safetyFactor
  /\ 0 < blueprint.utilityScore

EpochsMonotonic epochs :=
  StrictScaleAscent t_0 -> t_lithic -> t_biotic -> t_obs
proposition.plain: Every constructed monument, path, and autonomous rover appears only in the builder epoch at present observation and satisfies Heyman middle-third equilibrium with at least a two-to-one safety factor.

theorems.name: epochsStrictlyMonotonic
theorems.how: Proved by constructive kernel evaluation over the four cosmological expansion epochs from initial seed to present observation

theorems.name: allSevenBlueprintsEquilibrium
theorems.how: Proved by kernel decision over all seven constructed sanctuary structures and the autonomous perimeter sentinel rover

theorems.name: unstableAndPreBuilderRefused
theorems.statement: blueprintValid preBuilderSample = false /\ blueprintValid unstableEccentricitySample = false
theorems.how: Proved by kernel evaluation showing pre-builder epochs and middle-third statics violations are rejected
